Lolalāṅgūlastotra
on Hanumān. VRI. I. 2297. Oudh XIV. 100 (acc. to Rudra-yāmala).

Lolimba(mma)dīpikā
--name of C. by Śukhānandanātha on Vaidyajīvana of Lolimbarāja.
Pt.. with text, Brahma Press, Lahore, 1872.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 1478-79.

Lolimbarāja
son of Divākara, patronized by Harihara. sometimes also called a. Rolimbarāja.
On the ref.. to him in anthologies of Veṇīdatta (1644 C. E.) an. Siddhicandra (1588-1666 C. E.), see P. K. Gode, NIA. VIII. p. 2; for more also see Gode P.K. Lolimbarāja [Page315-b]
an. His works, Indian Culture Vol. VII. iii. p.. 327-33 an. 447-56.
--Upāṅgalalitāpūjākalpa. Trav. Uni. 2031.
--Grahabhāvaphala. RORI. X. 2066 (inc.).
--Camatkāracintāmaṇi. med. See under the text.
Addl. mss. :
RORI. II. B. 5043. XX. 1363. SB. New D..
XII. 45320. Wai D. II. 9690.
--Dakṣiṇakālikāmānasapūjāstotra. SB. New D.. V. iii. 75096.
--Bhavānīmānasapūjāvidhi. SB. New D.. II. iii. 59561.
--Mūtratailaparīkṣā. IM. 64.
--Ratnakalācaritra. med. B. IV. 234. IO. 3929.
--Lolimbarājīya. med. See below.
--Vaidyajīvana. RORI. IX. 1719.
--Vaidyadarpaṇa. VRI. I. 3239.
--Vaidyavallabha. Rajasthan Jain Pt. V. p. 1077 (in a collection).
--Vaidyavinoda. Bṛhatsūcī, Nepal V. p. 74 (inc.).
--Vaidyavilāsa (?) Khn. 88. See Harivilāsa.
--Vaidyāvataṃsa nighaṇṭu. Baroda II. 10981.
--Sundaradāmodarakāvya. Adyar.
--Harivilāsamahākāvya. RORI. III. B. 6514.
For some of his works see Lolimbarāja granthāvalī (1. Vaidyāvataṃsa, 2. Camatkāracintāmaṇi, 3. Vaidyajīvana. 4. [Page316-a.
Ratnakalācaritra, 5. Vaidyakakāvya saṅgraha adn 6. Harivilāsamahākāvya) Chow. Skt. Pratishthan, Varanasi. |26|315-316|

Lolimbarājīya
med. by Lolimbarāja. CPB. 4968-72. Oppert I. 6654. 7629. II. 3316. Tirupati (RSVP). 3112.

Lollaṭa
alias Aparājiti. ancient authority on Alaṅkāra. Especially interpreter of Bharata's Rasasūtra, how ever no work of this is extant. C. 900 C. E. Kashmīrian.
See S. N. Dasgupta, HSL. Classical Period, Vol. I. p. 523.
--C. on Nāṭyaśāstra.
Q. See V. Raghavan, Abhinavagupta an. his works, p.. 131 ff; in Kāvyamīmāṃsā; q. by Bhaṭṭa Someśvara in his C. Saṅketa on the Kāvyaprakāśa of Mammaṭa, BBRAS. 135; in Saṅgītaratoākara of Śārṅgadeva, IO. 1117.

Lollaṭācārya
q. by Śrīdhara in his Smṛtyarthasāra, IO. 1543; in Śrāddha-kālikā of Nārāyaṇa; Ṣaḍaśiti of Nandapaṇḍita; an. Śrāddhasāgara of Kullūka.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1217b.
--Śrāddhaprakaraṇa. Jaipur Mus. Ser. 7. p.. 217-18 (with Extr.).

Lollamahādeva
poet patronized by King Prola Verma Reddy of Addanki, an. [Page316-b]
grandfather of Kumāragiri alias Vasantarāja (a. of Vasantarājīya).
See Somasekhara Sarma, His.. of Reddi Kingdoms, Andhra University (1948), p.. 122 ff. 462.

Lollalakśmaṇārya
--Daivajñavallabha. jy. VVRI. I. p. 87 (2 mss.
; 1 inc.). Extr. II. p. 443.
